newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: AIR NZ TO RELAUNCH FLIGHTS TO VANCOUVER.
newsitem.headline: AIR NZ TO RELAUNCH FLIGHTS TO VANCOUVER.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Thursday it would re-launch two services a week to Vancouver when the airline's new alliance agreement with Air Canada takes effect on October 26.
The services, departing from Auckland, will stop over at Honolulu, with passengers changing to a chartered Air Canada aircraft.
They will depart Auckland on Monday and Thursday, with the Thursday service travelling via Fiji.
A third weekly service offering normal interline connections to Vancouver at Honolulu will depart from Auckland on Saturday. A fourth interline service is planned for mid-December.
Air New Zealand said the alliance agreement allowed it direct access back into the Canadian marketplace.
